results.content: # Trump approval sinks to new low in Fox News poll. President Donald Trump's approval rating has fallen to a new low in Fox News polling, as voters express deep dissatisfaction with his handling of inflation and the economy and Democrats widen their advantage ahead of November's midterm elections. The survey, released Oct. 14, found Trump's approval rating at 36%, while 64% of registered voters said they disapproved of his job performance. According to Fox News, that marks the lowest approval rating the president has received in the network's polling during either of his two terms in the White House. According to the poll, 77% of voters disapproved of Trump's handling of inflation. Fox News
results.title: Trump approval sinks to new low in Fox News poll - USA Today

results.content: # Trump approval rating falls to career low in new poll. President Donald Trump’s approval rating has fallen to a new record low, with less than one-third of Americans approving of the president’s job performance, according to a new Reuters/Ipsos poll. The poll, released on Oct. 19, found Trump’s approval rating at 31%, the lowest the president has seen in Reuters/Ipsos tracking in either term, and a one-point dip from his previous career low recorded two weeks ago. In a new Washington Post/ABC News/Ipsos poll, Trump’s approval rating hit a record low for the pollster, reaching 33%. results.content: A fresh round of polling is flashing new warning signs for President Donald Trump and Republicans ahead of the midterm elections. With control of Congress on the line, surveys released this week found Trump's approval rating near second-term lows while Democratic voters reported significantly greater enthusiasm about voting in November. One of the clearest warning signs for Republicans came from a Reuters/Ipsos survey released this week. Just 39% said they were satisfied with the direction of the country, down from 65% at the start of Trump's term and the lowest level recorded during his second presidency.
